files.plugin.json.gz: A gzipped JSON object from each path to its UTF-8 text: plugins/ia/scripts/** as scripts/**, plugins/ia/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, plugins/ia/config/qualified-process-tools.json, and kits/ia-kb/** (inventarch/ia-kb-kit 0.9.0, releases format 2) as config/kits/ia-kb/**, unchanged.
files.bindings.json: The consumer workspace's .ia/bindings.json: knowledge.find to kb-retrieve and knowledge.check to kb-check. Written by hand; generate.mjs reads it.
files.golden-find.json: The plugin's resolve.mjs --entry knowledge --activity find --root <ROOT>/consumer --project consumer --task golden --subject sha256:<sha256 of 'the decision records'>, with IA_HOME=<ROOT>/home, IA_CORE_KITS_DIR=<ROOT>/plugin/config/kits and IA_CLI_PATH at the built @inventarch/cli; the temporary root written as <ROOT> with forward slashes, the envelope removed, and the digest recomputed over that content with the plugin's own packetDigest.
files.golden-check.json: As golden-find.json, then --activity check in the same task (pin revision 2).
files.golden-pin.json: <ROOT>/home/work-v1/consumer/golden/binding.json after both runs, without createdAt, the root written as for the packets.
